parameters.question: Generate polynomial features up to degree 3 and all pairwise interaction terms for numeric columns; compare feature index-to-name mappings. Column order, row order, and header labels may differ.

Compare scaled polynomial (degree up to 3) and pairwise interaction feature tables generated from numeric columns; values must match within 1% relative absolute error; row order, column order, and header labels may differ (e.g., 'x0^2' vs 'col_a^2', 'a b' vs 'a*b').
